3._section_summary: This section describes the measures used in a single study with 247 female participants (mean age 29.8 years, mean BMI 30.53). Participants completed the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and the Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI) to assess sexual functioning across six domains. 4._section_summary: This section presents hierarchical multiple regression analyses (Table 2) testing whether body appreciation predicts sexual function outcomes (FSFI subscales and full scale) above and beyond age and partner status, and whether BMI moderates this relationship. The study included 246 female participants. Results indicated that body appreciation significantly predicted sexual arousal, satisfaction, orgasm, and overall sexual function after controlling for age and partner status, supporting Hypothesis 2. However, BMI did not significantly moderate these relationships, so Hypothesis 3 was not supported.
